The meanings are different, but I am not sure, do we need that level of precision in this dictionary? I also hesitated to split the (1) meaning in hwy ‘werden, entstehen’: we have werden-entstehen ‘возникать’ and werden-verwandeln ‘становиться кем-то или чем-то’. I think in the case of hwy this range of meaning of werden is natural, like in old Russian становиться has these two meanings (И стал свет), though in modern Russian it is impossible (И появился свет). summary: Intentional knockdown is clear in JL 12.13/7 and wrestling contexts; loss at Talay 1/155 repeats inherited LB 155 and does not justify renumbering or deleting tentative I.5. Neutral fox placement already occurs in the entry, so PrS 30/16 does not by itself force a new laying sense.

I.2 šlomo and I.3 hawar are already numbered light-verb senses. Targets take ʕal, while MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/71 has lu+hawār. New cross and harmful-breath expressions belong in Idiomatic phrases.

Stem II agricultural examples distinguish winnowing from threshing and sieving and depend on wind. The nominal deroyo is assigned Nomen Actionis; it is not evidence for a new finite Infinitiv paradigm.
Preserve gdəretulle, Cyrillic ә and source spellings. Preterit-wa church demolition is a new box, not a separate blasting sense. Inanimate blow subject at 53/184 extends ordinary knockdown causation.
Search dray ṣlibo found the inherited dry example and an ʕwq quotation, no separate idiom; dərabbi nafas search returned no match. No external origin asserted.
Clarify dorəlle mi ḍarbo at 61/363; exact construction and parsing remain uncertain, so no new sense or example is accepted.
Confirm droyo as projectile firing at MAC Ishaq Material culture/35; finite forms and scope beyond artillery are not attested here.
Confirm dərabbi segmentation and the harmful-breath/evil-eye value of nafas at PrS 57/34.
Does the intentional/accidental contrast warrant a future subsense split? Current evidence supports keeping existing 1 and tentative 5 with unchanged numbers.
Verify the equation of old prs page/verse references and current PrS text/verse references; duplicate contexts are not independent attestations.
